articles.mainIdea: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Oklo, Vistra, Opendoor, Intel, GM, Revolution Medicines, Tilray, and More
articles.summary: Barrons.com: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Oklo, Vistra, Opendoor, Intel, GM, Revolution Medicines, Tilray, and More. Stocks rose Friday after fresh jobs data showed U.S. unemployment ticked down in December and a potential Supreme Court ruling on tariffs failed to pan out. Vistra stock surged 11% and Oklo jumped 7.9% after the nuclear energy companies unveiled separate agreements to provide power to Meta Platforms in order to support the hyperscaler’s data-center campus in Ohio. Meta inched up 1.1%. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, DHI, GM, INTC, META, OKLO, OPEN, RKT, RVMD, TLRY, UWMC, VST.

articles.title: Merck in Talks to Buy Revolution Medicines for Around $30 Billion
articles.mainIdea: Merck in Talks to Buy Revolution Medicines for Around $30 Billion
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Merck in Talks to Buy Revolution Medicines for Around $30 Billion. Merck is in talks to acquire Revolution Medicines in a deal that could value it at around $30 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. A deal for the cancer-drug biotech could come as soon as later this month, the people said, cautioning the talks could still fall apart or another suitor could prevail. Merck has been discussing a deal valued between $28 billion and $32 billion, the people added. Related tickers mentioned: MRK, RVMD.

articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: What Catalysts Could Shift AbbVie’s Story As Analysts Rework Targets And Drug Expectations. AbbVie’s latest valuation update comes with only a marginal trim to its fair value estimate, shifting from about US$244.68 to roughly US$244.56 per share, even as analysts reassess the story around its key drug franchises. The discount rate and long term revenue growth assumptions have been tweaked only slightly, reflecting how bullish and bearish views are being fine tuned rather than completely rewritten as new research lands.
